stripe.name: Stripe

fee.text: US account: 2.9% + 30¢, international cards +1.5%, currency conversion +1%. Hong Kong: 3.4% + HK$2.35, international +0.5%, conversion +2%. UK: international cards 3.15% + 20p, conversion +2%. Subscriptions through Stripe Billing +0.7%.

cn-company.note: no accounts for mainland China; open with a Hong Kong or US company instead

hk-company.note: a local bank account and address are needed

us-company.note: a US bank account and mailing address; a non-US owner without SSN gives a local tax ID

uk-company.note: a UK account: UK cards 1.5% + 20p, international cards 3.15% + 20p, +2% if currency conversion is needed

stripe.payout: to a bank account in the account's country (not a virtual account)
stripe.review_time: activation after the website and business details check out
stripe.chargebacks: card networks treat 0.7% as excessive; Stripe can hold a reserve when disputes rise
notes: Not a Merchant of Record: you handle sales tax and VAT yourself, or add Managed Payments (Stripe as MoR, +3.5%, for fully automated digital products; open to businesses in the US, Canada, 31 European countries, Australia, Hong Kong, Japan and Singapore).

zh.fee: 美国账户 2.9% + 30 美分，国际卡 +1.5%，换汇 +1%；香港账户 3.4% + 2.35 港元，国际卡 +0.5%，换汇 +2%；英国账户国际卡 3.15% + 20 便士，换汇 +2%；用 Stripe Billing 收订阅另加 0.7%。

entities.cn-company: 不支持中国大陆，要用香港或美国公司开
entities.hk-company: 需要香港本地银行账户和地址
entities.us-company: 需要美国银行账户和通信地址；没有 SSN 的非美国负责人提供本国税号
entities.uk-company: 英国账户：英国卡 1.5% + 20 便士，国际卡 3.15% + 20 便士，需要换汇另加 2%

zh.payout: 打到账户所在国的银行账户（不接受虚拟账户）
zh.review_time: 网站和公司信息核实后激活
zh.chargebacks: 卡组织把 0.7% 视为过高；拒付变多时 Stripe 可能冻结一部分款项
notes: 不是 MoR：销售税和增值税要你自己报，或者开 Managed Payments（Stripe 代收税，每笔多收 3.5%，只卖全自动交付的数字产品；面向美国、加拿大、31 个欧洲国家、澳大利亚、香港、日本和新加坡的商家）。

uk-company.note: international card rate; 20p counted as US$0.27

paddle.name: Paddle

cn-individual.note: individuals and sole traders are accepted (they skip business verification), China is not on the unsupported list, and CNY is paid by bank wire

cn-company.note: accepted: business verification asks for registration documents and every owner of 25% or more; CNY is paid by bank wire

uk-company.note: the UK is not on Paddle's unsupported list; GBP to a UK bank is usually free

paddle.payout: monthly by wire or Payoneer, minimum US$100; CNY by bank wire
paddle.review_time: most checkout domains are approved automatically; a manual review takes 5–7 business days
paddle.chargebacks: keep chargebacks under 0.65% of volume; US$20 per chargeback
notes: Identity is checked through Sumsub (ID, proof of address, sometimes a selfie).

entities.cn-individual: 接受个人和个体经营（不用做公司验证），中国不在不支持名单上，可以按人民币电汇出款
entities.cn-company: 接受：公司验证要注册文件和持股 25% 以上的股东；可以按人民币电汇出款
entities.uk-company: 英国不在 Paddle 的不支持名单上；英镑打到英国银行通常免费

zh.payout: 每月一次，电汇或 Payoneer，最低 100 美元；可以人民币电汇
zh.review_time: 大多数结账域名自动通过；人工审核要 5–7 个工作日
zh.chargebacks: 拒付要低于交易额的 0.65%；每笔拒付收 20 美元
notes: 身份通过 Sumsub 核验（证件、地址证明，有时要自拍）。

lemonsqueezy.name: Lemon Squeezy

cn-individual.note: payouts reach mainland China only through PayPal; signing up from mainland China is not stated

uk-company.note: the UK is on the bank-payout list; bank payouts outside the US cost 1%

lemonsqueezy.payout: twice a month in USD after a 13-day hold, minimum US$50; bank payouts outside the US 1%, PayPal 3% capped at US$30
lemonsqueezy.chargebacks: too many chargebacks can suspend the account; US$15 per dispute
notes: Owned by Stripe; in January 2026 its CEO said the team is building toward Stripe Managed Payments and that support has slowed (https://www.lemonsqueezy.com/blog/2026-update).

entities.cn-individual: 只能通过 PayPal 提现到中国大陆；官方没说中国大陆能不能注册
entities.uk-company: 英国在银行出款名单上；美国以外的银行出款收 1%

zh.payout: 每月两次按美元出款，先押 13 天，最低 50 美元；美国以外银行出款收 1%，PayPal 收 3%（最高 30 美元）
zh.chargebacks: 拒付太多会被停用；每笔争议收 15 美元
notes: 已被 Stripe 收购；2026 年 1 月 CEO 公开说团队在转向 Stripe Managed Payments，支持变慢了（https://www.lemonsqueezy.com/blog/2026-update）。

creem.name: Creem

cn-individual.note: payouts to Alipay, up to CNY 50,000 a payout and CNY 300,000–600,000 a year

cn-company.note: payouts to a local bank account

uk-company.note: the UK is supported; a business is paid into a business account in its own name

creem.payout: 1st and 15th of the month after a 7–12-day risk hold; fee US$/€7 or 1%, whichever is higher; minimum US$/€50
creem.chargebacks: excessive chargebacks can suspend the account; US$/€25 per chargeback
notes: A rejection is final for that store and that business.
Restricted products (services, API resellers, generative AI) need earlier processor history and chargeback and refund rates.

entities.cn-individual: 提现到支付宝，单笔最多 5 万元，每年 30–60 万元
entities.uk-company: 支持英国；公司要打到公司名下的对公账户

zh.payout: 每月 1 号和 15 号出款，先押 7–12 天；手续费 7 美元/欧元或 1%，取高者；最低 50 美元/欧元
zh.chargebacks: 拒付过多会被停用；每笔拒付收 25 美元/欧元
notes: 被拒是终局：这个店铺和这家公司都不能再申请。
受限产品（服务、API 转售、生成式 AI）要提供以往的收款记录、拒付率和退款率。

dodo.name: Dodo Payments

cn-individual.note: China is on the accepted list (from 23 March 2026); ID and selfie through Persona

cn-company.note: every director and every owner of 10% or more needs an ID from a listed country

uk-company.note: the UK is on the accepted list; UK entities also file Form W-8BEN-E, and every director and 10% owner needs an ID from a listed country

dodo.payout: SWIFT or local transfer to an account in your own or your company's name, minimum US$50; US$5 under US$1,000; US$25 for USD wires
dodo.chargebacks: high refund or dispute rates trigger a review; alerts can refund buyers before a chargeback
notes: Payouts start only after a separate monitoring review.

entities.cn-individual: 中国在可接受名单上（2026 年 3 月 23 日起）；证件和自拍通过 Persona 核验
entities.cn-company: 每位董事和持股 10% 以上的股东，都要有名单内国家的证件
entities.uk-company: 英国在可接受名单上；英国公司还要交 W-8BEN-E 税表，每位董事和持股 10% 以上的股东都要有名单内国家的证件

zh.payout: SWIFT 或本地转账到你本人或公司名下的账户，最低 50 美元；低于 1,000 美元收 5 美元，美元电汇收 25 美元
zh.review_time: 1–3 个工作日；可以申诉一次
zh.chargebacks: 退款或争议率高会触发复审；预警可以在拒付发生前先给买家退款
notes: 出款前还要单独过一次监控审核。

polar.name: Polar

fee.text: new organizations 5% + 50¢ (from 27 May 2026), or monthly plans at 3.4–3.8%; international +1.5%.

cn-individual.note: payouts go only through Stripe Connect Express, which does not reach mainland China

uk-company.note: the UK is on the payout list; a UK bank account in GBP through Stripe Connect Express

polar.payout: manual withdrawals, minimum US$10; a 7-day settlement delay for organizations created after 12 May 2026
polar.review_time: the first review takes up to 14 days
polar.chargebacks: keep chargebacks under 0.4%; US$15 per dispute

entities.cn-individual: 只能通过 Stripe Connect Express 出款，不支持中国大陆
entities.uk-company: 英国在出款名单上；通过 Stripe Connect Express 打到英国的英镑账户

zh.payout: 手动提现，最低 10 美元；2026 年 5 月 12 日以后建的组织，款项先押 7 天
zh.review_time: 第一次审核最长 14 天
zh.chargebacks: 拒付要低于 0.4%；每笔争议收 15 美元

waffo.name: Waffo Pancake

cn-individual.note: payouts to a bank card or Alipay in mainland China

cn-company.note: registered businesses can apply, but company payout accounts are not live yet: payouts go to the verified individual's account

hk-company.note: registered businesses can apply, but company payout accounts are not live yet: payouts go to the verified individual's account

us-company.note: registered businesses can apply, but company payout accounts are not live yet: payouts go to the verified individual's account

uk-company.note: no payouts to the UK: Waffo Pancake pays out only in mainland China, Hong Kong, the US, Japan, South Korea and Singapore

waffo.payout: after about 10 business days; 1% (minimum US$10); to mainland China (bank card or Alipay, Alipay up to RMB 50,000 a payout and RMB 300,000 a year), Hong Kong, the US, Japan, Korea and Singapore only
notes: Also takes WeChat Pay for one-time orders in USD or CNY.

zh.fee: 3.9% + 50 美分，没有国际和订阅附加费。

entities.cn-individual: 提现到中国大陆的银行卡或支付宝
entities.cn-company: 公司可以申请，但公司收款账户还没开放：钱打到验证过身份的个人账户
entities.hk-company: 公司可以申请，但公司收款账户还没开放：钱打到验证过身份的个人账户
entities.us-company: 公司可以申请，但公司收款账户还没开放：钱打到验证过身份的个人账户
entities.uk-company: 不出款到英国：Waffo Pancake 只出款到中国大陆、香港、美国、日本、韩国和新加坡

zh.payout: 约 10 个工作日后出款；手续费 1%（最低 10 美元）；只能提现到中国大陆（银行卡或支付宝，支付宝单笔最多 5 万元、每年 30 万元）、香港、美国、日本、韩国和新加坡
notes: 一次性订单还能用微信支付付款（美元或人民币）。

gumroad.name: Gumroad

fee.text: 10% + 50¢ plus card processing 2.9% + 30¢; sales that come from Gumroad Discover pay 30%.

cn-individual.note: payouts to mainland China only through PayPal

cn-company.note: payouts to mainland China only through PayPal

uk-company.note: UK bank payouts in GBP; a business must use a bank account in its country of registration

gumroad.payout: to a local bank account in a listed country, or PayPal where banks are not supported (US dollars, 2%); minimum US$100, a 7-day hold
gumroad.review_time: no website review: Gumroad hosts the product page; an account review of 1–3 weeks before the first payout
notes: A Merchant of Record since 2025; its prohibited list was not checked for this tool, so its category stances read as not addressed.

zh.fee: 10% + 50 美分，另加刷卡费 2.9% + 30 美分；来自 Gumroad Discover 的订单抽 30%。

entities.cn-individual: 提现到中国大陆只能走 PayPal
entities.cn-company: 提现到中国大陆只能走 PayPal
entities.uk-company: 可以按英镑打到英国银行；公司要用注册国家的银行账户

zh.payout: 打到受支持国家的本地银行账户，不支持银行的地方用 PayPal（美元，2%）；最低 100 美元，押款 7 天
zh.review_time: 不审网站：产品页由 Gumroad 托管；第一笔出款前有 1–3 周的账户审核
notes: 2025 年起是 MoR；这个工具没核对它的禁售清单，所以类目一栏都显示「政策没提」。

entities_zh.us-company: 美国公司（LLC 或股份公司）
